source='''def rotate_cw(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    return [[grid[n - 1 - c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]

def rotate_ccw(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    return [[grid[c][n - 1 - r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]

def transform(grid):
    cw = rotate_cw(grid)
    ccw = rotate_ccw(grid)
    half = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [grid[r] + cw[r] for r in range(len(grid))] + [ccw[r] + half[r] for r in range(len(grid))]
'''
